description: Complete guide to Vladivostok, Primorsky Krai: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Vladivostok is a city in Primorsky Krai with a population of 605,000. Russia’s Pacific port city, a dynamic hub for trade and culture, home to the famous Golden Horn Bridge and Russky Island. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
